caption: The drawing depicts a single, central object rendered in grayscale. The object appears to be an iron or metal stand constructed from twisted and hammered rods. At the base, four elongated, slightly curved rods extend downwards and outward, connecting to form a rounded, circular support ring that sits flat against the surface. The central vertical rod is twisted, and near the top, a short horizontal arm extends outward, ending in a small, cylindrical cup-like holder. Above this, the vertical rod splits into two flat prongs that are slightly apart. The overall texture of the metal is uneven and rugged, emphasizing the hand-forged appearance. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, with a light, neutral tone, allowing the dark, monochromatic object to stand out in composition.
title: Rush and Candle Holder
